background_image.description: Path to background image used by Eterm

developers.description: List of Debian developers to display (required at runtime; defaults to empty list if omitted — debroster will then show no names, only background and scrolling setup). Each entry contains a developer's name and optional email for comment documentation only (not used by debroster). Note: debroster only reads the first line per entry — the email is for human reference in the generated config only and does not affect program behavior.

scroll_speed.description: Scroll speed in milliseconds between updates

geometry.description: Eterm window geometry in WxH+X+Y format

double_buffer.description: Enable double buffering for smoother rendering
